summary: The Forgotten Realms Dungeons & Dragons RPG series spanning BioWare's Infinity Engine classics, console action-RPG spin-offs, Beamdog Enhanced Editions, and Larian's modern sequel.

entries.title: Baldur's Gate 3

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with current patches.

primary.version: Baldur's Gate 3 PC release with current patches
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route for Larian's sequel, with the broadest mod/capture options. Console, Mac, Linux, and cloud routes do not add exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows build through Steam or GOG with the latest patches; use the Digital Deluxe/physical Deluxe only for extras, not required gameplay content.
